Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Welcome! The best place to start is by taking three simple measurements inside your cabinet: the width (between the door hinges), the depth (back wall to inside the closed door), and the height (from the base or shelf up to the shelf above).
Our standard 10.6" depth units fit most standard kitchen cabinets. A popular option for beginners is our 222x2x11 3-drawer rack, which holds 30 standard spice jars in a compact space.
If you'd like help finding the exact fit for your space, you can also use our online Product Selector tool to calculate the right dimensions.
